_comment: DEC-BXSNAP2-PARITY-GOLDEN-001 — observational parity oracle for a future Rust arrow_table_to_bars port. Frozen bxsnap2 digests of the current Python bar-materialization path. Regenerate ONLY on a deliberate Python-path change (new DEC id + MIGRATION note; every run identity goes cold). Changes NO production behaviour.
